svg.title: Exclusive SIES destinations
svg.desc: Exclusive SIES destinations. Modern definition. SIES destinations in the 2 years after expected school completion. Adjusted difference (pp). Nominal uncertainty interval: 98.75 %. No observed SIES record: +2.4 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE; University only: +0.8 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE; IP/CFT only: −2.6 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE; University and IP/CFT: −0.6 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE. Later closures in comparison schools were not verified; Limited school-level precision
